name: add-new-feature
description: Add --format json output to the CLI. End-to-end feature addition.
task: The justhtml CLI in src/justhtml/__main__.py currently outputs parsed HTML as text. Add a --format flag that accepts 'text' (default) or 'json'. When 'json' is selected, output the parsed document as a JSON structure with tag names and text content. Test it by running: .venv/bin/python -m justhtml --format json with some sample HTML input.
